set.description: NSI-2022 is a point-based U.S. structure inventory maintained by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers for natural hazard assessment, especially flood risk, with public fields describing occupancy, building characteristics, valuation, and day/night population attributes.
Global HAND provides 30 m and 90 m height-above-nearest-drainage layers with 100 and 1000 river head threshold cell variants, curated by Donchyts and Deltares.

Microsoft Bing Global Mined Roads is a vector road dataset derived from Bing Maps imagery collected between 2020 and 2022, including all detected roads and roads inferred to be missing from OpenStreetMap.

EOG Annual VIIRS Night Time Light is a consistently processed global annual nighttime lights product derived from monthly cloud-free VIIRS radiance composites, using version 2.1 processing to reduce ephemeral lights and background noise.

This dataset suite provides predictive global power-system layers derived from open data, including mapped distribution and transmission lines, estimated low-voltage infrastructure density, and predicted grid-connected locations.

HRDEM is Canada’s high-resolution digital elevation model product suite, including dataset footprints as well as 1 m digital surface and digital terrain models produced under the National Elevation Data Strategy.

Carbon Mapper methane emission products provide airborne plume observations, basemap imagery, and plume feature layers for detected methane point-source emissions collected during 2020-2021 campaigns.
swissSURFACE3D Raster DSM is a high-resolution Swiss digital surface model derived from airborne LiDAR, representing the land surface together with vegetation, buildings, bridges, and water features.
Global Building Atlas provides tiled building polygon data for large-scale building footprint analysis and mapping.
This layer provides gridMET-derived gridded fire danger and fuel-moisture related variables based on daily ~4 km surface meteorological data for the contiguous United States.
